short: Claude Code hook scripts: session/tool-call context injection
is: The Claude Code hook scripts wired in .claude/settings.json (PreToolUse/SessionStart) that inject factual, deterministic context into a session — as distinct from scripts/*.sh, which back `just` dev-loop recipes.
conventions: POSIX sh + jq + awk only — no `sed` (aliased to `sd` on some dev machines), no python3/perl; always exit 0, never fail the event that triggered them.
Injected text is factual statements only, never imperatives — command-shaped injected context can trip prompt-injection defenses.
scripts/hooks/lib.sh's hooks_are_off is the shared kill switch (ZURFUR_HOOKS_OFF containing the hook's name or `all`; an untracked .claude/hooks.off file) sourced by every hook.

scripts/hooks/lib.sh's utf8_safe_head backs a byte truncation off to a valid UTF-8 boundary via `iconv -c` (POSIX-specified, best-effort — falls back to a plain cut if absent); every hard byte cap goes through it, never a bare `head -c`.
Every *.sh here has a *.test.sh beside it; `just hooks-test` runs them all. Test fixtures use jq/awk only, matching the hooks' own runtime dependencies.

fs.name: design-refs.jq
fs.role: jq filter: buckets a node chain's refs into governs-this-file vs. other-pages-cited for design-refs.sh

fs.name: design-refs.sh
fs.role: PreToolUse hook (Read|Edit|Write|MultiEdit) — injects the design-corpus refs for the touched file's node chain

fs.name: design-refs.test.sh
fs.role: fixture-driven tests for design-refs.sh, using nodes-stub.sh

fs.name: jq-broken-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for a jq that exits 2 on every call, driven by design-refs.test.sh via ZURFUR_JQ_BIN

fs.name: jq-partial-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for a jq that writes a truncated fragment then exits 1, driven by design-refs.test.sh via ZURFUR_JQ_BIN

fs.name: jq-slow-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for a jq that sleeps on its final call, driven by design-refs.test.sh via ZURFUR_JQ_BIN to test SIGTERM cleanup

fs.name: lib.sh
fs.role: shared hooks_are_off/neutralize/cap_bytes/safe_state_dir/bounded_append/utf8_safe_head helpers, sourced by every hook script

fs.name: nodes-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for the `nodes` binary, driven by design-refs.test.sh via ZURFUR_NODES_BIN

fs.name: pins.sh
fs.role: SubagentStart / SessionStart(compact|resume) hook — re-states ../../.claude/pins.md (+ the untracked user-level pins file) to a subagent or after compaction

fs.name: pins.test.sh
fs.role: fixture-driven tests for pins.sh, plus shape checks on the tracked ../../.claude/pins.md

fs.name: stat-fail-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for a `stat` that always fails, driven by pins.test.sh via ZURFUR_STAT_BIN to prove the local-pins-file ownership check fails closed

fs.name: stat-foreign-owner-stub.sh
fs.role: test double for a `stat` that always reports a foreign uid, driven by pins.test.sh via ZURFUR_STAT_BIN
